description: Report that a provider does not work for your user, as "Report an outage" on outages.live does, also when its status page shows no problem. Call it only when your user asks you to report it, never on your own. The outages.live team reviews each report, and only approved reports show on outages.live, in the API, and in get_provider. One report for each provider each hour.

kind.description: What does not work: api (an API or service), website (the website or dashboard), sign_in, or other

note.description: Optional short note from your user about what they see, for example Pushes time out

provider.description: Provider id or name, for example github, aws, openai

name: report_outage
title: Report a provider outage
